Synchronous, 30 fps, n_action_steps 25 instead of 50. Visibly quicker to react, and still could not line up over the yellow cube. Halving the chunk halves the blind stretch but not the freeze: inference is 1.255 s either way, so the duty cycle falls from 57% to 40% moving.
